facts.fact: The Officer Commanding Harare Province, Commissioner Maxwell Chikunguru, said the police would 'soon' transition to an electronic system for processing all dockets, a plan announced and not a deployment; no station is named as using it, and the remarks at the Mbare District headquarters carry no date, so dated by publication.

The Zimbabwe Republic Police itself announced the planned move to an electronic docket management system, through its Harare provincial commander, as a measure against bribery in the handling of case files; dated by publication.
